description_en: Queries the network information of a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBClusterNetInfo接口查询指定集群的网络信息
name: DescribeClusterNetInfo

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of an Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the details of clusters in a specific region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

AnalyticDB (default): the AnalyticDB for MySQL engine.

ClickHouse: the wide table engine
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB（默认）：AnalyticDB for MySQL引擎。
Clickhouse：宽表引擎
parameters.name: engine

ClusterNetworkType.description_en: The network type of the cluster. The value is always VPC, as this is the only supported network type
ClusterNetworkType.description_zh: 集群网络类型，当前仅支持专有网络，取值固定为VPC

items.description_en: Details for a single network connection

ConnectionString.description_en:
The connection string of the cluster.

If the network type is VPC, `ConnectionString` is the VPC connection string.

If the network type is Public, `ConnectionString` is the public network connection string
ConnectionString.description_zh:
集群的网络连接地址。
当网络类型为VPC时，ConnectionString为VPC地址。
当网络类型为Public时，ConnectionString为公网地址

ConnectionStringPrefix.description_en:
The prefix of the connection string.

If the network type is VPC, `ConnectionStringPrefix` is the prefix of the VPC connection string.

If the network type is Public, `ConnectionStringPrefix` is the prefix of the public network connection string
ConnectionStringPrefix.description_zh:
网络地址的前缀。
当网络类型为VPC时，ConnectionStringPrefix为VPC地址的前辍。
当网络类型为Public时，ConnectionStringPrefix为数据库公网连接地址的前缀

IPAddress.description_en:
The IP address.

If the network type is VPC, `IPAddress` is the private IP address.

If the network type is Public, `IPAddress` is the public IP address for connecting to the database
IPAddress.description_zh:
IP地址。
当网络类型为VPC时，IPAddress为私网IP地址。
当网络类型为Public时，IPAddress为连接数据库的客户端IP地址

NetType.description_en:
The network type. Valid values:

Public: the public network.

VPC: the VPC network
NetType.description_zh:
网络类型。取值说明：
Public：公网。
VPC：VPC网络

Port.description_en: The port number. The value is always 3306

Protocol.description_en:
The protocol. Valid values:

tcp: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP).

http: Hypertext Transfer Protocol.

https: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure.

mysql: MySQL protocol
Protocol.description_zh:
协议类型。取值：

tcp：传输控制协议。
http：超文本传输协议。
https：超文本传输安全协议。
mysql：MySQL协议

VPCId.description_en:
The VPC ID.

If the value of `NetType` is `Public`, this parameter is empty
VPCId.description_zh:
VPC ID。
当NetType取值为Public时，VPC ID返回为空

VSwitchId.description_en:
The vSwitch ID.

If the value of `NetType` is `Public`, this parameter is empty
VSwitchId.description_zh:
交换机ID。
当NetType取值为Public时，交换机ID返回为空
